title: Beach side apartments/dormitories
content: Okay, it's crazy because I've seen people discussing the fact that there are the beach side apartments with sort of a Tampa Florida kind of vibe, but has anyone else been in the upper levels of the apartments? It seems like I always end up in the upper levels (they have really long elevators...) and that typically two to four floors are dedicated to some sort of dormitory situation with big halls and individual rooms... I'm always either checking in or trying to leave. but I've stayed with family in the apartments across from the ones with dormitories. anybody else experience this?
